svg.title: Where a home’s electricity goes, per 100 kilowatt-hours
svg.desc: Waffle chart: a 10 by 10 grid of 100 squares, one square per percent of annual household electricity use. Heating & cooling 34; Water heating 18; Appliances & plug loads 16; Electric vehicle 14; Lighting 9; Cooking 9. Heating and cooling dominate at 34 squares.
svg.text: Heating & cooling eats a third of home power
Share of annual household electricity use · one square = 1 %
